overview_description.description:
Blueberry Medical provides parents with live access to top pediatricians for a flat monthly rate. Parents get round-the-clock support from a team of top pediatricians who can diagnose illnesses, provide advice and prescribe medication when medically necessary. Parents can send images and videos through a smartphone app, and chat with pediatricians through a text-like interface to ask questions and get care.

Blueberry Medical was founded on 2017 and is headquartered in Boynton Beach, Florida.

product.name: Unlimited 24/7 Pediatric Telehealth Care
product.description: Provides parents with unlimited access to board-certified pediatricians via chat, call, or video at any time for diagnosis, treatment plans, prescriptions, and school notes.

product.name: At-Home Medical Kit
product.description: A kit containing medical devices that allow parents to perform pediatric exams at home, including ear/nose/throat exams and vital sign measurements.

product.name: Digital Prescription Savings Card
product.description: A digital card that provides families with discounts on medications, potentially saving up to 80% on prescriptions.

identifier.value: Developmental, Behavioral, and Mental Health Screening

product.name: Developmental, Behavioral, and Mental Health Screening
product.description: Regular screening services to identify developmental, behavioral, and mental health concerns in children before they escalate.

product.name: Blueberry Membership Gift Cards
product.description: Prepaid memberships that include access to Blueberry's pediatric telehealth services and the at-home medical kit, available as gifts for families.
